name: astra-direct-seed2
title: gpt-6.2-astra acting directly on the same episodes

setting.harness: RoboProbe RoboDojo_Agent_L3_Inspect_EEF, the benchmark team's reference harness for a model acting directly
setting.layouts: Generalization tasks: standard layouts 1-5 and randomized layouts 1-5; other tasks: standard layouts 1-10
setting.protocol: the model acts directly through the harness on the same 340 episodes as the SEEK log; nothing carries over between episodes
setting.aggregation: task = mean over scored episodes; category = mean over its tasks; Average = mean over categories

episodes.note: the provider refused one wrist-camera image under its content policy (HTTP 400) in each of the four runs of this episode; following the reference harness, which counts a provider refusal as a model refusal, it is scored 0
